title: Hyena
wikitext:
[[image:HyenaPurple.png|thumb|]]

Hyenas are large [[dog]]-like [[beast]]s found in the most barren areas of [[Kalimdor]].  They are most dangerous when travelling in packs.  Hyenas often have an ability to inflict dangerous diseases on those who fight them.  [[Centaur]] [[hunter]]s in the [[Barrens]] and [[Desolace]] often keep them as [[pet]]s.  Hyenas are [[skinnable]].  Found in [[The Barrens]], [[Desolace]], [[Tanaris]], the [[Blasted Lands]], the [[Scarlet Monastery]], the [[Western Plaguelands]], and [[Thousand Needles]]

== Notable Hyenas ==
* [[Ravage (Hyena)|Ravage]]
* [[Snort the Heckler]]

== Types of Hyenas ==
* [[Hecklefang Hyena]]

==  As A [[Hunter]] Pet ==
* Have medium HP, medium armor, and medium damage.
* Eats only fruit and meat.
* Can learn [[Bite]], [[Dash]], [[Growl]], and [[Cower]].  They have yet to recieve their species skill.
* [[Ravage (Hyena)|Ravage]] (1.3 attack speed) and Scarlet Tracking Hound (1.5 attack speed) are good choices for a pet.
* Typically not very popular as a hunter pet.
